description: The exact git invocations that compute a Factory run's patch id (sha256 of the --binary staged patch against the run's base commit, .factory/, system/loop/ and llm-doc/loop/test/ excluded). Mirrored by extension/agents/factory-ship.mjs (STAGED_PATCH_EXCLUDES) and desktop/src-tauri/src/loop_worktree.rs (EXCLUDES, staged_add_args, staged_diff_args); both test suites compare their builders to this file so a change on one side alone fails.
hash: sha256 of the diff stdout bytes
